theorems.name: Submission.cmb_measureRepresentation_continuous_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)), CompactlyContainedOpen W U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v → ∀ (B C : ℝ), 0 ≤ B → T.massOn W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B → ∀ ω : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) n, Continuous ω → tsupport ω ⊆ W → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ C) → Integrable (fun x => v x (ω x)) μ ∧ |∫ x, v x (ω x) ∂μ| ≤ B * C
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
